answer.rationale: Prioritize an accelerated incumbent negotiation tied to renewal: continuity is critical with the line at 94% committed volume and only 14 days remaining, while market benchmarking and a multi-year/volume commitment may create the savings needed toward the 18% mandate. Verify that the prior pricing and payment gains, and multi-year discount, apply to this component and do not introduce volume, flexibility, or service-scope liabilities. Do not switch or add a source this cycle because onboarding or qualification could increase near-term delivery risk.
